notes: This catalog contains metadata only. A separate research archive reports 1,267 saved originals; those files are not supplied or reverified here, and none is a public saved copy.
Only pinned datasets listed in data/document-inputs.json were processed; all-source and all-record coverage is not claimed.
The QPR horizon and quarter-panel JSON files and the 4,440-row CSV were indexed using pinned Git blobs.
Raw private F31 workbooks, household/address-bearing identifiers, narratives and credentials are not republished. Original public PDFs remain outside the site until safety and rights review.
Citation counts are dataset-location references, not distinct financial observations; overlapping releases and source roles are retained separately.
Source discovery is not exhaustive. A missing file or failed request is unknown/unavailable, never zero. Distinct SHA-256 vintages are retained, even when URLs repeat.
Report approval and source-validation status are inherited evidence labels, not approval to redistribute a document.
coverage.archiveAvailabilityScope: The savedOriginal flag records a prior private-archive receipt, not a file available on this site or permission to republish it.
